from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import List, Optional

from .astnode import (
    BlockNode,
    Bold,
    Blockquote,
    CodeBlock,
    Document,
    Heading,
    HorizontalRule,
    Image,
    InlineCode,
    InlineNode,
    Italic,
    LineBreak,
    Link,
    ListItem,
    OrderedList,
    Paragraph,
    Strikethrough,
    Text,
    UnorderedList,

# ── Block-level patterns ────────────────────────────────────────────

_ATX_HEADING = re.compile(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)\s*#*\s*$")
_FENCED_CODE_OPEN = re.compile(r"^(`{3,}|~{3,})([a-zA-Z0-9+-]*)\s*$")
_BLOCKQUOTE = re.compile(r"^>\s?(.*)$")
_UL_ITEM = re.compile(r"^(?:[-*+])\s+(.*?)$")
_OL_ITEM = re.compile(r"^(\d+)\.\s+(.*?)$")
_HR = re.compile(r"^(?:[-*_])(?:\s*[-*_]){2,}$")

# ── Inline patterns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

_INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`")
_BOLD = re.compile(r"(?:\*{2}|_{2})(.+?)\1")
_ITALIC = re.compile(r"(?<![*])(?:[*]|[_])(.+?)(?![*])\1")
_STRIKETHROUGH = re.compile(r"~~(.+?)~~")
_IMAGE = re.compile(r"!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)")
_LINK = re.compile(r"(?<!!)\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)")
_LINE_BREAK_SPACES = re.compile(r"  +$")
_LINE_BREAK_BACKSLASH = re.compile(r"\\$")


def parse(markdown: str) -> Document:
    """Parse a Markdown string into an AST Document."""
    lines = markdown.splitlines()
    blocks = _parse_blocks(lines)
    return Document(children=blocks)

# ── Pass 1: Block-level parsing ─────────────────────────────────────

def _parse_blocks(lines: List[str]) -> List[BlockNode]:
    """Parse lines into block-level AST nodes."""
    blocks: List[BlockNode] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]

        # Blank line — skip
        if not line.strip():
            i += 1
            continue

        # Fenced code block
        m = _FENCED_CODE_OPEN.match(line)
        if m:
            fence_char, lang = m.group(1)[0], m.group(2).strip()
            code_lines: List[str] = []
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines):
                if lines[i].startswith(fence_char * 3) and not lines[i][len(fence_char) :].strip():
                    break
                code_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            blocks.append(CodeBlock(lang=lang or None, value="\n".join(code_lines)))
            continue

        # ATX heading
        m = _ATX_HEADING.match(line)
        if m:
            level = len(m.group(1))
            text = m.group(2).strip()
            blocks.append(Heading(level=level, children=_parse_inline(text)))
            i += 1
            continue

        # Horizontal rule
        if _HR.match(line):
            blocks.append(HorizontalRule())
            i += 1
            continue

        # Blockquote
        m = _BLOCKQUOTE.match(line)
        if m:
            bq_lines: List[str] = []
            while i < len(lines) and _BLOCKQUOTE.match(lines[i]):
                bq_lines.append(_BLOCKQUOTE.match(lines[i]).group(1))
                i += 1
            blocks.append(Blockquote(children=_parse_blocks(bq_lines)))
            continue

        # Unordered list
        m = _UL_ITEM.match(line)
        if m:
            items: List[ListItem] = []
            while i < len(lines):
                lm = _UL_ITEM.match(lines[i])
                if lm:
                    items.append(ListItem(children=_parse_inline(lm.group(1))))
                    i += 1
                elif lines[i].strip() == "":
                    break
                else:
                    break
            blocks.append(UnorderedList(items=items))
            continue

        # Ordered list
        m = _OL_ITEM.match(line)
        if m:
            start = int(m.group(1))
            items: List[ListItem] = []
            while i < len(lines):
                lm = _OL_ITEM.match(lines[i])
                if lm:
                    items.append(ListItem(children=_parse_inline(lm.group(2))))
                    i += 1
                elif lines[i].strip() == "":
                    break
                else:
                    break
            blocks.append(OrderedList(start=start, items=items))
            continue

        # Paragraph — collect consecutive non-blank, non-special lines
        para_lines: List[str] = []
        while i < len(lines):
            if not lines[i].strip():
                break
            if _ATX_HEADING.match(lines[i]):
                break
            if _FENCED_CODE_OPEN.match(lines[i]):
                break
            if _HR.match(lines[i]):
                break
            if _BLOCKQUOTE.match(lines[i]):
                break
            if _UL_ITEM.match(lines[i]):
                break
            if _OL_ITEM.match(lines[i]):
                break
            para_lines.append(lines[i])
            i += 1
        if para_lines:
            blocks.append(Paragraph(children=_parse_inline("\n".join(para_lines))))

    return blocks

# ── Pass 2: Inline parsing ──────────────────────────────────────────

def _parse_inline(text: str) -> List[InlineNode]:
    """Parse inline Markdown into a list of inline AST nodes."""
    # Handle line breaks first by splitting on hard breaks
    segments = _split_line_breaks(text)
    result: List[InlineNode] = []
    for idx, seg in enumerate(segments):
        if idx > 0:
            result.append(LineBreak())
        result.extend(_parse_inline_content(seg))
    return result


def _split_line_breaks(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split text on hard line breaks (two trailing spaces or backslash)."""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    segments: List[str] = []
    current_lines: List[str] = []

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if _LINE_BREAK_SPACES.match(line) and i < len(lines) - 1:
            # Hard break via trailing spaces
            stripped = line.rstrip()
            current_lines.append(stripped)
            segments.append("\n".join(current_lines))
            current_lines = []
        elif _LINE_BREAK_BACKSLASH.match(line) and i < len(lines) - 1:
            # Hard break via backslash
            stripped = line[:-1]
            current_lines.append(stripped)
            segments.append("\n".join(current_lines))
            current_lines = []
        else:
            current_lines.append(line)

    if current_lines:
        segments.append("\n".join(current_lines))

    return segments


def _parse_inline_content(text: str) -> List[InlineNode]:
    """Parse inline content (no line breaks) into AST nodes."""
    result: List[InlineNode] = []
    pos = 0

    while pos < len(text):
        # Inline code — highest priority to avoid parsing inside backticks
        m = _INLINE_CODE.search(text, pos)
        if m and (m.start() == pos or not result):
            pass  # will be handled below

        # Try each pattern at current position
        matched = False

        # Inline code
        m = _INLINE_CODE.match(text, pos)
        if m:
            result.append(InlineCode(value=m.group(1)))
            pos = m.end()
            continue

        # Strikethrough
        m = _STRIKETHROUGH.match(text, pos)
        if m:
            result.append(Strikethrough(children=_parse_inline_content(m.group(1))))
            pos = m.end()
            continue

        # Image (must come before link to avoid matching the leading [)
        m = _IMAGE.match(text, pos)
        if m:
            alt_text = m.group(1)
            rest = m.group(2).strip()
            src, title = _parse_link_destination(rest)
            result.append(Image(src=src, alt=alt_text, title=title))
            pos = m.end()
            continue

        # Link
        m = _LINK.match(text, pos)
        if m:
            link_text = m.group(1)
            rest = m.group(2).strip()
            url, title = _parse_link_destination(rest)
            result.append(Link(url=url, title=title, children=_parse_inline_content(link_text)))
            pos = m.end()
            continue

        # Bold (** or __)
        m = _BOLD.match(text, pos)
        if m:
            result.append(Bold(children=_parse_inline_content(m.group(1))))
            pos = m.end()
            continue

        # Italic (* or _)
        m = _ITALIC.match(text, pos)
        if m:
            result.append(Italic(children=_parse_inline_content(m.group(1))))
            pos = m.end()
            continue

        # Plain text — consume until next special character
        end = len(text)
        for pattern in [_INLINE_CODE, _STRIKETHROUGH, _IMAGE, _LINK, _BOLD, _ITALIC]:
            pm = pattern.search(text, pos + 1) if pos < len(text) - 1 else None
            if pm and pm.start() < end:
                end = pm.start()
        # Also check for line break markers
        if text[pos:].startswith("  ") or text[pos:].endswith("\\"):
            pass

        result.append(Text(value=text[pos:end]))
        pos = end

    return result


def _parse_link_destination(rest: str) -> tuple[str, Optional[str]]:
    """Parse a link/image destination and optional title.

    Formats:
      url
      url "title"
      url 'title'
      url (title)
    """
    # Try quoted titles
    for quote in ['"', "'", "("]:
        if rest.startswith(quote):
            end = rest.find(quote, 1)
            if end != -1:
                return rest[1:end], None
    # Check for title after URL
    m = re.match(r'^(\S+)\s+["\'(](.+?)["\')]', rest)
    if m:
        return m.group(1), m.group(2)
    return rest, None
